name: Polycon International Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1991, Polycon International Ltd manufactures and trades PET Items.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
PIL is promoted and managed by Baids
family. It is engaged in the manufacturing 
and trading of PET products like:
a) PET Bottles
b) PET Jars
c) PET Preforms
d) Caps & Lids
e) Water Storage Tanks
f) PVC Profiles & Sections etc.

cons: Stock is trading at 5.58 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -5.98% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -17.5% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
